# CytoarchitectonicAxis

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A data-driven cellular axis from 'peaked' (high hierarchical differentiation) to 'flat' (low differentiation) identified via BigBrain 3D histology within the DMN. This axis provides a continuous gradient for mapping computational complexity in TCC, enabling graded resource allocation rather than binary classification.
